declared_before: Opening the fresh 3e-5 paired-validation output; all final-test and external-model inference
success: Original full output must end normally and satisfy the predeclared semantic/exact rubric; truncation or unknown stopping cannot pass. Scene is original-image grounded, not a phrase-only proxy.
comparison: Arithmetic mean of six domain success rates; raw numerators/denominators and each regression stay visible. This is a declared teaching preference, not a universal metric.
decision: Apply the unchanged parent eligibility requirements and six-domain mean to each adapter against its paired base. Choose the eligible adapter with the highest mean only if it strictly beats base. If neither does, choose base. A tie with base prefers base; a tie between adapters prefers the original candidate (no claimed benefit from an equal gentle score). Final-test and external outputs never select the candidate.
limits: Validation is small and partly course-authored; no general capability or statistical-significance guarantee.
Never pick a version by final-test/external scores.
Prior 96-token baseline remains an early route record; do not attribute differences in generation budget to training.
protocol_history: The original paired semantic review was completed before declaring this controlled second candidate: it shows improvements and five truncated photo descriptions. Only the learning rate changes; this protocol is declared before opening the gentle outputs, not before seeing the original validation.
